correctness.rationale: Independent zero set in the crown graph lies on one side, is empty, or is precisely one deleted-matching pair. In no-zero and matched-two-zero cases lower bound 2n; in one-side-zero case total support forces at least two positive vertices on that side, while a zero forces a two on the other, proving n+3. Equality classification gives 2n(n-1) n>=4, and n=3 counts 1+12+12. Exhaustive definition-based enumeration n=3..6 reproduces minima and counts.
